description: Verify a card with the clearing provider (Tranzila) and save its token to an organization, so an AI agent with the customer's card can put a payment method on file without the hosted page. The raw card is sent only to the PCI-compliant clearing provider and never stored. For a hosted alternative (customer types the card), use gambot_create_payment_link.
name: gambot_add_payment_method
title: Add payment method (card on file)
